name: UniCon
blurb: Latvia's own Comic Con in Riga since 2013, covering cosplay, anime, gaming, comics, esports and tabletop RPGs across two annual festivals.

editions.evidence: Homepage key visual and hero text: 'UNICON WINTER ... INTERNATIONAL EXHIBITION CENTER RIGA, KIPSALA 8 - 10 JANUARY 2027', with a live countdown (95d as of 2026-10-05, landing on 2027-01-08).

notes: UniCon runs 'two big annual festivals' per its own FAQ (About section: 'from our two big annual festivals to monthly community events'): the long-running summer/main UniCon (UniCon 2026, its 14th edition, ran 14-16 August 2026 per WebSearch — already before today's window, so not listed) and UniCon Winter, which has the 2027-01-08 edition on the current homepage. No August/summer 2027 date is announced yet, so only Winter 2027 is listed; a future pass should add the next summer edition once it appears. Could not confirm a separate organizing-company legal name within budget, so organizer is left blank. Refute pass (2026-10-05): dropped the whole 15-name lineup. A fresh re-extract of /guests shows the page's own <title> is still 'Unicon 2026 Guests', and the lead card's full bio text reads 'J-Pop music artist MION will be returning to Latvia and appearing at UniCon 2026!' -- a WebSearch confirms 'UniCon 2026' is the con's 14th edition, 14-16 August 2026, i.e. the un-suffixed main show that already happened, not 'UniCon Winter 2027'. No other guest card names either year; none say 'Winter' or '2027'. The Winter-2027-titled homepage (confirmed via a fresh render: title 'UniCon Winter 2027', correct Jan 8-10 2027 countdown) still deep-links into this same unrefreshed /guests page, and one of its own hero images is literally named 'guest-coming-soon-image.avif' -- this is the carried-over August 2026 lineup under new template dates, not an announced Winter 2027 booking, so guests reverts to none-yet pending a page that actually names 2027 or Winter.
